verdict.rationale: First-party plugins bring AI analysis of user data into ChatGPT/Codex chats: the Slack plugin summarizes channels and drafts replies, Codex Security confirms vulnerability findings in your code, and the Google Drive and Notion plugins cover documents and research. Plugins add these skills and tools to chats in ChatGPT and Codex. Each capability is documented only as a one-line description, with no detail on what insights are produced or how good they are. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of insight or suggestion generation, coverage beyond a few connector-specific use cases, and independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality.
